drhp.business: HIRECT designs and manufactures advanced power electronics, traction transformers, power converters, and indigenous locomotive propulsion systems for mission-critical mobility and industrial applications. The Company serves complex ecosystems across railway transportation, power generation, defence, metals, and chemical industries, with approximately 90% of revenue from the railway vertical. It is transitioning from standalone components to comprehensive sub-systems and system-level solutions, supported by backward integration and a growing international footprint.
drhp.end_markets: Railway and Transportation|Power Generation|Defense|Metal and Steel|Chemical and Petrochemical
drhp.expansion: HIRECT is transitioning from a component supplier to a comprehensive system-level solutions provider, covering propulsion systems, brake systems, communication systems, HVAC, and advanced power electronics. A key milestone was the official field trials of its indigenous propulsion system at Western Railway, with commercialization underway and initial orders of approximately ₹50 crore secured. ins.thesis: Q1FY26 saw 58.5% revenue growth and 66.9% EBITDA growth driven by record order book of INR1,022cr and successful commissioning of indigenous propulsion system; what matters is the imminent 50,000km field trial completion in August 2025 and the high-margin advanced passenger propulsion order pipeline, which could unlock 10% market share in 1,500+ annual locomotive tenders.
